items.exampleEn: She was unmistakably the best player on the field.
items.exampleZh: 她毫無疑問是場上最好的球員。

items.exampleEn: Rocks and tables are inanimate objects.
items.exampleZh: 石頭和桌子都是沒有生命的物體。

items.exampleEn: The new version adds more functionality but is harder to use.
items.exampleZh: 新版本增加了更多功能，但比較難用。

items.exampleEn: These thin shoes are unsuitable for running.
items.exampleZh: 這雙薄底鞋不適合跑步。

items.exampleEn: The team captain was outwardly confident before the final, but his hands were shaking.
items.exampleZh: 隊長在決賽前表面上很有自信，但他的雙手在發抖。

items.exampleEn: The students' disorderly behavior annoyed the teacher.
items.exampleZh: 學生們沒規矩的行為讓老師很不高興。

items.exampleEn: The new shop needs a short, catchy name.
items.exampleZh: 這家新店需要一個簡短又好記的名字。
items.glossZh: 朗朗上口的；容易記住的

items.exampleEn: The room was suitably decorated for a birthday party.
items.exampleZh: 房間裝飾得很適合辦生日派對。

items.sentenceEn: The children walked out of the hall in a disorderly line.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們排著亂七八糟的隊伍走出禮堂。

items.audioEn: Please bring suitably warm clothes; it snows up there in the evening.
items.audioZh: 請帶適當的保暖衣物，那裡傍晚會下雪。

items.sentenceEn: Toys are inanimate, but young children often talk to them as if they were alive.
items.sentenceZh: 玩具沒有生命，但小孩常常把它們當成活的一樣跟它們說話。

items.sentenceEn: That laugh is unmistakably my brother's; I'd know it anywhere.
items.sentenceZh: 那個笑聲一聽就是我兄弟的，在哪裡我都認得出來。

items.stemEn: The ____ song was stuck in my head all day.
items.stemZh: 那首朗朗上口的歌在我腦中轉了一整天。

items.stemEn: This hiking trail is ____ for small children because it is very steep.
items.stemZh: 這條登山步道很陡，不適合小孩子走。

items.passageEn: Last month, my sister's team had to make a short video for an innovative new desk lamp. Their first idea was a funny song with a catchy tune, but the boss said it was unsuitable because it made the lamp look like a toy. So they focused on the lamp's functionality instead: it can change color, follow your hand and turn itself off. Outwardly, my sister stayed calm, but she worked late every night. In the end, the video was a great success.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我姊妹的團隊要替一款創新的新檯燈拍一支短片。他們的第一個點子是一首旋律洗腦的搞笑歌曲，但老闆說不適合，因為那會讓檯燈看起來像玩具。所以他們改成主打檯燈的功能：它能變換顏色、跟著你的手移動，還會自己關燈。我的姊妹表面上很冷靜，但每天晚上都工作到很晚。最後，這支影片大獲成功。

questions.questionZh: 老闆為什麼不採用搞笑歌曲？
影片最後主打檯燈的什麼？

items.promptZh: 請穿著得體去參加面試。
referenceEn: Please dress suitably for the interview.
Please be suitably dressed for your interview.
rubricZh: 要用 suitably（例如 dress suitably、be suitably dressed）
「參加面試」可寫，例如 for the interview、for your interview 等

items.promptZh: 車站裡的人群很混亂，大家都在推擠。
referenceEn: The crowd at the station was disorderly, and everyone was pushing.
There was a disorderly crowd at the station, with people pushing each other.
rubricZh: disorderly 當形容詞（例如 was disorderly、a disorderly crowd 等）
「推擠」可寫，例如 pushing、pushing each other 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 was、is 等）
